interpretation: No exact/RC match and no >=0.90-coverage near-overlap; shared 20-mers are partial (max coverage ~0.68) and consistent with short repetitive STR/homopolymer motifs rather than promoter homology.

raw.independence_statement: Exact and 20-mer checks are bounded; near-overlap uses a documented 0.90-coverage block criterion on candidate pairs only. STR variable regions are hg38 STR+flank genomic fragments assayed upstream of a minP-GFP reporter, structurally distinct from the 133bp hg19 autonomous core promoters.
